cues.text: Paperplay — research papers with interactive, source-linked figures.
Change an input and replay actual Dijkstra computations. Source text stays beside the figure.
Compare implementations on identical inputs. Operation counts are measured; no speedup is invented.
A third family: numerical optimization. Inspect the quadratic matrix and computed convergence.
Share a reproducible experiment or export a bundle. Including source text and PDFs is explicit.
This PDF was analyzed by the official Meta API. The saved result reopens without another model request.
Conceptual walkthroughs and checked computations have separate evidence labels. Prepared papers also work without credits.
